# UX & Analytics Requirements Quality Checklist: Goal Arrival Estimations Average Weights & Section Reordering

**Purpose**: Validate requirements completeness, clarity, and consistency for displaying rolling/weighted average weights in Goal Arrival Estimations and reordering the section in `WeightProgressionHeroCard`
**Created**: 2026-11-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Mathematical & Display-Unit Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK001 Are the rolling average window boundaries (`[today - (N - 1), today]`) and 1-decimal display-unit rounding (`round1InUnit`) explicitly specified for `7D`, `14D`, `21D`, and `28D` weights? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Is the `4:3:2:1` recency-weighted average weight formula (`sum(w_i * avgWeight1InUnit_i) / sum(w_i)` rounded to 1 decimal place) unambiguously defined across full and partial horizon availability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Does the specification explicitly state that projected weeks and arrival dates remain anchored to the current 7D remaining weight to goal rather than recalculating from each row's weight? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are fallback rules defined when a horizon has a valid `PaceRateResult` but sparse recent weigh-in logs? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Visual Formatting & Section Order Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK005 Are the exact string formats specified for both `HorizonEstimationRow.formatLeftLabel()` (`"7D (-0.49 kg/wk · 81.5 kg)"`) and `HorizonEstimationRow.formatWeightedSummary()` (`"(Weighted pace of -0.39 kg/wk · 82.3 kg · 7.9 wks · 26 Dec 2026)"`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Is the formatting behavior defined for `Stalled`, `Projected` capped (`> 1 year`), and `NotEnoughData` states? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK007 Is the exact vertical section order inside `WeightProgressionHeroCard` (`Hero Centerpiece / Daily Weigh-In` -> `Goal Arrival Estimations` -> `Pace & Linear Targets` -> `2x2 Pace Grid`) unambiguously specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 Are backward-compatibility defaults (`averageWeightDisplay: String? = null`) specified for direct `HorizonRowState` construction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]

## Accessibility & Responsive Layout Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK009 Are merged TalkBack `contentDescription` requirements specified for both the `Weighted Average` row and the `7D`–`28D` rows with the added weights? [Completeness, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK010 Are viewport width (`360dp`) and font scaling (`1.0f` and `1.3f`) criteria specified to prevent clipping or overflow with wider left labels? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

- All 10 requirements-quality items (`CHK001`–`CHK010`) audited against `spec.md` and `plan.md` and verified complete.
